description: PAID, per call: search Health Canada's published Recalls and Safety Alerts open data by keyword, category, recall id and date range (give at least one). Returns up to 10 notices, each with the dates of the data. You are not charged when nothing matches or when the data is out of date.

category.description: A category as the notice publishes it, for example Food or Medical device.

date_from.description: Notice date on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_to.description: Notice date on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

keyword.description: Words to find in the title, product, category and issue. Every word must appear.

recall_id.description: The notice id exactly as published.

name: search_health_canada_recalls
